name: Entropic Cut
body:
School evocation; Level magus 2, occultist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2; Specialty School (Void)

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft. level)
Target 1 creature + 1 creature/3 levels
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You tear a hole in reality pulling energy from a realm of endless madness and form it into a black blade the width of a needle. You slice through your opponents with the blade of entropy, causing wounds that are sickly and black. Each target takes 2d6 damage. A successful Fortitude halves this damage but it affects undead and constructs normally.

You may instead focus on a single target rather than multiple. If you target only one creature and it fails its save, the target is also staggered for a number of rounds equal to your caster level.
